pages.title: Distress Beacon
pages.text: A last resort, after the old EPIRBs: a battery, a transmitter and a strobe in a floating orange case. $(thing)Right click$() opens its arming cover (sneak and right click shuts it); $(thing)hold right click$() to switch it on. Once on it cannot be switched off. It works in your inventory, or thrown in the water, where it floats and does not despawn while it sends.

pages.title: What It Sends
pages.text: Every 50 seconds, an alert with its position and your name on $(thing)161.975 MHz$(). A $(l:radiocraft:radios/commercial_radios)commercial VHF mobile$(/l) with a channel on 161.975 hears it (a marine radio does not: its DSC is channel 70 only), and the $(l:radiocraft:computer/distress)DISTRESS$(/l) program through one. All the time, a homing tone a $(l:radiocraft:direction_finding/handheld_df)direction finder$(/l) can follow.

pages.title: One Use
pages.text: Its battery lasts one Minecraft day of sending (the tooltip counts it down). Then it sends a last SPENT alert and is a $(item)Spent Distress Beacon$(), good for nothing. It goes as far as a handheld does, so hills and roofs cut it short: get to open water or high ground.
A diamond for the transmitter, so it is not made lightly.
